title: A REQUEST
text:
Dear Dhan Team,

I would like to appreciate the excellent work you’ve done with the Dhan DEX D3 platform. As an active F&O trader, I find it to be one of the best trading platforms available in India. The interface is clean, fast, and designed with traders in mind.

I have a few suggestions that I believe would make the platform even better.

1. Display P&L amount on Chart-based Target & Stop Loss

When placing a target and stop loss directly on the chart, the platform currently displays only the quantity. It would be extremely helpful if it also displayed the estimated profit or loss in monetary terms (₹), based on the target and stop-loss levels.

Seeing the actual amount at risk and the potential reward directly on the chart would improve decision-making and make trade management much more intuitive.

2. Reset Entry Price and P&L on Re-entry

This is the feature I would request the most.

Suppose I enter a contract at ₹200 and exit at ₹300. Later, I re-enter the same contract at ₹260. Instead of showing my fresh entry at ₹260, the chart continues to display an averaged or previous entry reference. This makes it difficult to judge the current trade accurately.

A bigger concern is the P&L display. For example, if I take a ₹10,000 loss on a contract, exit the position, and later find a fresh setup to re-enter the same contract, the platform still shows the previous ₹10,000 loss. Psychologically, this is distracting and can negatively influence trading decisions.

Every new position should be treated as a completely fresh trade. Once a position is closed, the next entry in the same contract should display:

* The new entry price only.
* Profit/Loss calculated only from the current open position.
* No carry-forward of the previous trade’s realized P&L on the active position display.

Traders can always view their overall realized P&L in the Positions, Orders, or Trade Book sections. However, the chart should reflect only the currently active trade, allowing traders to make unbiased decisions based on the present setup rather than previous outcomes.

I believe these enhancements would significantly improve the trading experience, especially for active intraday F&O traders.

Thank you for building such a powerful platform and for continuously improving it. I hope you will consider these suggestions in a future update.

Kind regards,

Areeb Khan

title: Regression, Not Progression – Bring Back Trailing Stop-Loss!
text:
I have been a loyal user of Dhan primarily for its superior execution features, but the latest update is a massive step backward for serious traders. The removal of the Trailing Stop-Loss (TSL) feature is unacceptable and significantly increases risk exposure for intraday players.

The latest update to the Dhan app is a massive regression in risk management and user experience. By removing the Trailing Stop-Loss (TSL) feature and restricting SL placement to only below the entry price, Dhan has stripped away the most vital tools for any disciplined trader.

Previously, one of the best things about Dhan was the "set and forget" convenience. I could take a trade, set my trailing SL, and go about my other work without being glued to the screen. Now, the app forces me into constant monitoring. Because I can no longer trail my SL into profit, I have to watch every tick. If I buy at 100 and the price reaches 145, I am forced to manually exit or risk a reversal hitting my original SL below 100. It has turned trading into a high-stress chore.

This update also ruins profit potential. To avoid a winning trade turning into a loss, I am now forced to set small targets of 10–20 points. If I aim for a 50-point target and the market hits 45 before reversing, I lose everything because I couldn't lock in gains at 30 or 40. Often, the trade hits my "forced" small target and then rallies to 50 anyway, meaning I’m missing out on significant moves just to play it safe.
Dhan collects its brokerage fees regardless of whether a trader wins or loses. However, by removing features that allow us to lock in profits, the platform is actively making it harder for users to survive. A trading app should empower its users with better technology, not take away essential safeguards. This update feels like a move to benefit the house rather than the trader.
I am extremely disappointed. This ignores the reality of market volatility and the basic principles of scaling out of positions. 

I strongly urge the Dhan team to restore the Trailing Stop-Loss and the ability to set SL above the buy price immediately. Until then, this is a 1-star experience for any serious trader.
